baseline: ZX bundle compiled with the base revision
candidate: ZX bundle compiled with the base revision plus literal Bool branch specialization
methodology: Pinned CPU 3 on physical Alpha. Both bundles use identical sources and the same in-process native runner. The runner includes exact-half lowering and multiplication by 31. The cc -O2 reference establishes the digest in the first round and rechecks it in subsequent rounds. Every ZX runner invocation verifies its digest. Runner order is shuffled. Each round contains 11 samples per runner, summarized after symmetric 1.5×IQR exclusion with interpolated quartiles. The same exclusion rule is applied to the round medians.
